# Computer Vision — NPTEL 106105216 study material (IIT Kharagpur, Prof. Jayanta Mukhopadhyay)

> Lecture slides, lecture transcripts, assignment solutions and handwritten-style study notes for weeks 1-12 of the NPTEL Computer Vision course. Every PDF has a plain-text copy; the per-week files below concatenate everything for that week, so read the text files rather than the PDFs. Slide text is the PDF text layer plus OCR, so equations there may be garbled; the transcript and the study notes are the cleanest sources.

- Website: https://pml2405.github.io/computer-vision-notes/
- Manifest (JSON): https://pml2405.github.io/computer-vision-notes/manifest.json
- All study notes in one file: https://pml2405.github.io/computer-vision-notes/text/all-notes.txt
